subject: Regression line for 2 groups in qplot figure

messages.author: 0b3b0c5e8917217c
messages.subject: Regression line for 2 groups in qplot figure
parts:
Hey folks,
Like many other posters here, I'm really new to R. I am trying to figure out how to add regression lines for two groups of data (migrant vs resident birds). I collected birds at three different locations and when I tried to add regression lines it does for each location for both migrants and residents. How do I get it so it's just for migrants overall and residents overall? Also, is it possible to change the color of the data points? Thanks in advance for any help!


R Script:
DDEplot = qplot(`Feather D`, log10(DDE), data = DDE.dat, shape = Location, color = Status, size = I(3))

DDEplot + ylab(expression(log~Sigma~DDE~ng/g~dw)) + xlab(expression(Feather~delta^2~H~"‰")) + theme_bw(base_family = "Times") + theme(plot.background = element_blank(),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

Have you looked at the examples in geom_smooth (http://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/geom_smooth.html)?
Map a variable to say color, group or fill and see magic happen. You may want to switch to ggplot.

Cheers,
Roman
